svg.aria-label: Where cards show up: every card always lives on its own page. That page has a Right now card where live rows show and quiet ones fold into one line. While a card matters, a copy appears on Home on its own, urgent ones first and quiet ones stacked under Lower priority. The copy goes away again when it stops mattering, and the card stays on its page.
